name: Tulsa County, Oklahoma (United States)
description: White field charged with the county logo: a light blue rounded shape bearing a white stylised letter t with a light blue map of the county and the Arkansas River.
history: Tulsa County is a county located in Oklahoma. The flag was adopted on 4 September 1973 (adopted by the Board of Commissioners on 4 September 1973 for the dedication of Estill Park, according to Flags of the World citing the Tulsa World).

features.role: rounded logo with a stylised letter t and a map of the county
